effects.display_name: Axing melee and Minotaur axe sprint modifier
actual_behavior: Minoshroom inherits BaseTFBoss, not Minotaur behavior; registerAttributes reuses Minotaur attributes: HP120, movement0.25, base ATTACK_DAMAGE2 (native attribute default), KR0.5. FinalizeSpawn invokes native Mob finalization, ordinary random armor population, then equips diamond_minotaur_axe and requests ordinary spawn enchantments. Diamond tier attack bonus3 + axe parameter6 supplies +9 MAINHAND attack; settled unenchanted total11. Equipment updates apply native attributes; the axe attack-speed modifier -3.2 does not set mob AI cadence. Armor is not guaranteed zero: native population probability0.15*specialDifficultyMultiplier and equipment/enchantment rolls remain. Minoshroom weapon enchantment chance0.25*specialMultiplier, armor0.5*specialMultiplier. Axe gold enchantability is22, inherited durability1561 for diamond; no boss attack helper invokes ItemStack.hurtEnemy/postHurtEnemy, so ordinary axe wear is not charged by these mob hits. Native Player use of the same axe retains ordinary wear. Mainhand drop chance0 affects loot only. Installed multiplayerFightAdjuster=NONE is reused; no HP difficulty phase/regen/berserk threshold exists in Minoshroom.

Priority3 native MeleeAttackGoal(speed1,false) uses live target, path or melee reach, native LOS and melee AABB. Requires every-tick update; attack counter decremented then tested, resets20 before dispatch, independent of hurt success. It calls Minoshroom.doHurtTarget, which REPLACES ordinary Mob.doHurtTarget with EntityUtil.properlyApplyCustomDamageSource using twilightforest:axing, direct=causing=Minoshroom. Effective attack attribute passes native EnchantmentHelper.modifyDamage before victim.hurt, but the helper supplies ATTACKER itself as the affected Entity argument instead of victim (unlike Mob.doHurtTarget); target-dependent enchantment evaluation therefore uses that wrong entity context. This is separate from the later knockback helper, which receives the victim. True enables enchantment-adjusted ATTACK_KNOCKBACK*0.5, attacker XZ velocity*0.6 when extra knockback>0, and native post-attack enchantments. Helper mistakenly calls setLastHurtMob(attacker itself), not victim; preserve this installed distinction. False suppresses those success callbacks; true need not mean HP loss. It is a vanilla-like extended melee package, not an invented ordinary mob_attack CUSTOM_DAMAGE. Axing is physical-tagged with normal armor/Resistance/protection/absorption/cooldown.

Registered ToolEvents.addExtraAxeChargingDamage listens to LivingIncomingDamageEvent: uncanceled, server target, DIRECT entity Living and sprinting, nonempty MAINHAND instanceof MinotaurAxeItem => current newDamage +7. No source-type or successful-hurt test. Native Player difficulty scaling happens before this incoming hook, so settled unenchanted charging hit is D(11)+7, not D(18); Normal18, Easy13.5, Hard23.5 before downstream mitigation. A zero Player request (including Peaceful scaling) returns before the incoming event and cannot gain the bonus. Enchantments/other hooks can change the input. The same hook works for native Player sprint attacks (player_attack source) and a Minotaur that actually spawned with gold_minotaur_axe; a plain golden axe fails the item predicate. It is not a charge-only tag, and it does not require CHARGING synced flag. Return-false shield/cooldown rejection can occur after the bonus event.

Victim Player native blocking remains its own subsystem. Exact244 Living shield processing follows incoming callbacks; nonprojectile direct Living source invokes Player.blockUsingShield, then attacker.canDisableShield. The default IItemExtension returns instanceof AxeItem, inherited unchanged by MinotaurAxeItem/KnightmetalAxeItem. Native Player.disableShield sets current use-item cooldown100, stops use, broadcasts30. This does not depend on the boss melee helper receiving true. Blocking requires native warmup>=5, source direction and no BYPASSES_SHIELD; shield durability request is native1+floor(blocked shield damage) when>=3, subject to ordinary durability/creative/enchantment handling. Twilight adds no extra Minoshroom shield-disable mechanic. Slam bypasses shield and does not enter that block callback. Knight Phantom shield defense has its own early return described separately.

No Minoshroom hurt/isInvulnerableTo override, no source-specific projectile/explosion immunity, shield phase, damage cap, special iframe or HP gate. Registered type is not fireproof and no fall-immunity tag includes Minoshroom; normal native damage, optional equipment, Resistance and hooks apply. Boss membership prevents natural freeze buildup/helper Frosted admission, not every externally delivered IS_FREEZING damage request. Home radius20 uses valid same-dimension strict block-position distanceSquared<400 for priority5 AttemptToGoHomeGoal(speed1.25); it is navigation, NOT Naga-style source/owner admission or invulnerability. Higher-priority combat may preempt home movement. Targeting: native nearest Player(false mustSee), retaliation; no bespoke in-home target gate. BaseTFBoss refuses mounts/portals and fluid pushing; water slowdown1; Base lavaHurt ignites5 seconds then requests ownerless minecraft:lava4; only true hurt calls killLavaAround. It scans bossBB.inflate9 in unit steps, replaces exact Blocks.LAVA with AIR, without mobGriefing/hardness/container checks. Rejected cooldown/invulnerability prevents cleanup; true with absorption may still clean. This is environmental recovery, not fire immunity. Base death removal at20, normal dead hurt rejection; no resurrection/regen. Peaceful restores spawner at loaded valid home then discards; no far-away despawn. Native boss spawner range9 and nearest PlayerY<spawnerY+4, nonPeaceful, finalize then assign home. Spawn eggs without home are a different setup. Synced charge flags/counters and goal state are not custom NBT-saved; native HP/equipment/home persist.

actual_behavior: PhantomWatchAndAttackGoal has no flags, canUse targetnonnull, default goal scheduling. With live target: lookAt(10,500); requires sensing LOS, postdecrement attackTime<=0, distance<2 and vertical BB overlap; resets20 before doHurtTarget, ignores return. Counter decreases only with live visible target (range test follows decrement); successful uninterrupted retry after21 visible goal calls, not fixed20 game ticks. Attacks can occur in any formation if eligible. Knight.doHurtTarget uses the same custom helper as Minoshroom with twilightforest:haunt direct=causing=Knight: attribute/enchantment damage with ATTACKER-as-affected-Entity in modifyDamage, success knockback/post-enchantment, erroneous lastHurtMob=self. HAUNT is magic-tagged, NOT armor-bypassing. Registered ToolEvents.doKnightmetalToolLogic at incoming, uncanceled/server/direct Living/nonempty mainhand: sword OR pick and target armorValue>0 adds int(2*armorCoverPercentage) to CURRENT newDamage if cover>0, else+2. Native cover=nonempty armor slots/total slots; quarter-covered target therefore adds0, half1, full2, while armor attribute without worn pieces adds2. Axe with armorValue==0 SETS newDamage=ORIGINAL damage+2 (can overwrite earlier hook changes), otherwise no bonus. Armor test is recipient before mitigation; no bypass. These hooks also apply to genuine native Player tool attacks; they do not run for ownerless ThrownWep sources. Player difficulty scaling precedes hook. Axe uses ordinary native Player shield disabling as described above; sword/pick do not gain it.

actual_behavior: Only PhantomThrowWeaponGoal in ATTACK_PLAYER_ATTACK with target and ticksProgress%4==0. Default goal scheduling and formation counter determine cadence; no unconditional every4 game-tick promise. Axe role creates NEW ThrownWep owned by boss, fresh plain knightmetal_axe, defaultdamage6 and gravity0.001, shoot speed0.75/inaccuracy1. Origin body-facing offset1, Y+height*.82; aims XZ to target and Y uses target minY+halfheight minus bossY+halfheight (not originY). Pick role emits8 fresh projectiles at45-degree increments, horizontal initial directions, radius1/Y+height*.82, speed0.5/inaccuracy1, setDamage3,setVelocity(.015) (the latter is GRAVITY, not launch speed), fresh knightmetal_pickaxe. No held-stack consumption, durability, pickup ammunition, enchantment copying or throw inventory pool. Sword emits none. Native ThrowableProjectile drag0.99 air/.8 water and configured gravity apply.

Types are IS_PROJECTILE and physical; armor/Resistance/protection/projectile protection/absorption/cooldown remain. No armor/shield bypass tag; missing source position itself prevents ordinary directional shield block. Missing direct Projectile means normal Living knockback direction uses no projectile reference. onHit calls inherited entity/block callback then server smoke event/discard unconditionally even when hurt false or target is excluded. Other Knights therefore consume a colliding throw without HP damage. No piercing/multi-hit/pickup/return/reuse mechanic.

Reloaded pick becomes empty-item AXE source, damage6/gravity.001, while owner UUID persists. Synced data is not NBT persistence. No custom lifetime counter; normal impact/removal/environment rules remain.
